correctness.rationale: Weighted-star arrowhead Schur complement gives exact follower inverse diag(0,1/w_i)+11^T/W. Squared-trace formula follows algebraically. An out-of-order leaf-only set is strictly improved either by substituting the hub if W<= (r+1)b, or by swapping the maximum selected b with a minimum unselected a under W>(r+1)b, using the explicit strictly negative exchange expression and its rigorous bound. Hub-selected sets are diagonal. Thus globally only two sorted candidate forms survive, for all positive real weights and budgets. Exact polynomial threshold and Pell-unit solution verified; standalone rational checker performed 9,018 matrix, 315 optimum, 4,949 threshold checks, strictly secondary to proof.
